posts.headline: Did You Know?
posts.body:
Your tongue holds more bacteria than any other part of your mouth.
Cleaning it daily can eliminate up to 70% of bad breath.

posts.headline: Fact
posts.body:
Protein requires 25–30% of its own calories to be digested.
Eating more protein literally boosts your metabolism.
posts.cta: Protein is the ultimate metabolism food.
